ai_summary: A. K. Capital Services Limited has formally applied to the BSE to reclassify A. K. Capital Markets Limited from its 'Promoter Group' to the 'Public' category under SEBI regulations. A key takeaway is that the entity being reclassified holds no shares (0.00%) in the company, ensuring this action will have no material impact on the company's shareholding pattern or promoter/public ownership percentages. This move appears to be a procedural update to the promoter group definition, reflecting a formal detachment rather than a substantive shift in control or equity.
